title: 2009 HMMT February Guts Problem 10
statement:
Let \(a, b\), and \(c\) be real numbers. Consider the system of simultaneous equations in variables \(x\) and \(y\) :

\[\begin{aligned}
a x+b y & =c-1 \\
(a+5) x+(b+3) y & =c+1
\end{aligned}\]

Determine the value(s) of \(c\) in terms of \(a\) such that the system always has a solution for any \(a\) and \(b\).

solutions.text: We have to only consider when the determinant of \(\left(\begin{array}{cc}a \\ a+5 & b \\ b+3\end{array}\right)\) is zero. That is, when \(b=3 a / 5\). Plugging in \(b=3 a / 5\), we find that \((a+5)(c-1)=a(c+1)\) or that \(c=2 a / 5+1\).
